_help: The intake questionnaire (spec 5.1), filled in by the client from a link on their phone. Each question: id (never rename once clients have answered), label, type (text, textarea, choice, multi), optional hint, options (for choice and multi), required, track (only shown for that track), other (adds an "Other" box), saves_to (also copies the answer onto the client or project: client.instagram, client.tiktok, client.website, client.channel, project.approver). The budget question uses terms.budget_ranges in settings.json and is skipped while that list is empty.
title: A few questions before we start
intro: This takes about five minutes. Your answers shape the proposal, so the more you tell us, the better it fits.

questions.label: Your business name and what you sell, in one or two sentences.
Who is your ideal customer?
Instagram
TikTok
Website
Who are your top two or three competitors?
What do you need from us?
What is the main goal?
What would make you say “this was worth it” three months from now?
Is there a deadline or a launch date?
Where will the content be used?
Send three accounts or videos you love, and say what you like about each.
Is there anything you do not want?
questions.hint: Styles, music, topics, people on camera

questions.label: Do you have brand guidelines, a logo pack, fonts and colours?
Who approves the work? One name only.
Where will we shoot, and are there days or hours we cannot shoot?
Who will be on camera? Are they comfortable with it?
What is your budget range?
How do you prefer we talk?
How often do you post now?
Who posts and replies to comments today?
Do you already have a script or concept, or do you need us to write it?
options: We have a script or concept

questions.label: Roughly how many products, rooms or people?
Do you need retouching?

thanks: We have your answers. We will come back to you with the proposal soon.
closed: Thank you, we have your answers. If something changed, just message us.
